mapper.sql: select *, (select username from sys_user where id = create_by) as createByName from sys_role
mapper.insert: insert into sys_role (role_name, remark, create_by, create_time, access, activation) values (#{bo.roleName}, #{bo.remark}, #{bo.createBy}, #{bo.createTime}, #{bo.access}, #{bo.activation})
mapper.select: select sr.* from sys_role sr left join sys_user_role sur on sr.id = sur.role_id left outer join sys_user su on su.id = sur.user_id where su.account = #{account}
select sr.* from sys_role sr left join sys_user_role sur on sr.id = sur.role_id left outer join sys_user su on su.id = sur.user_id where su.id = #{userId}
select sr.*, su.name as createByName from sys_role sr join sys_user_role sur on sr.create_by = sur.role_id join sys_user su on su.id = sur.user_id
